This looks like an arugula salad on a square plate of roughly 26 cm. The greens are lightly dressed and there are a few small pieces that could be cheese or nuts. The pile is loose and fairly low, so I estimate about 60 g of arugula. Adding roughly 10 g for the dressing and 10 g for the cheese or nuts gives about 80 g in total. Arugula has very few calories, about 15 kcal for 60 g. The dressing adds roughly 60 kcal and the cheese or nuts about 40 kcal, for a total near 115 kcal.
